cat > programs/task-a1c51a9e.py <<'PY'
def transform(grid):
    # Collapse consecutive runs of identical rows, then identical columns.
    rows = []
    for row in grid:
        if not rows or row != rows[-1]:
            rows.append(row[:])
    cols = []
    for j in range(len(rows[0])):
        col = [row[j] for row in rows]
        if not cols or col != cols[-1]:
            cols.append(col)
    return [[cols[j][i] for j in range(len(cols))] for i in range(len(rows))]
PY
